name: Yoyogi Kamo
source:
Owner and Principal of Yoyogi Married Women's Academy. No matter what happens, she maintains a gentle demeanor, enveloping lost students in her generous aura. 

Even when confronted with strange facts, her gentle admonishments somehow bring reassurance—perhaps due to her mysterious past...

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=106141&gc=gc] Getchu[/url]]
